                ys=[p[0] for p in c]; xs=[p[1] for p in c]
                cols={g[y][x] for y,x in c}

# Verify the rule on all four demos and test input.
def f(g):
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    O=[r[:] for r in g]
    ob=objs(g,bg)
    S=[o for o in ob if o['size']==1]
    T=[o for o in ob if o['size']>1]
    # anchor = rarest color of template that also appears as single pixels elsewhere
    sc=defaultdict(int)
    for s_ in S: sc[list(s_['colors'])[0]]+=1
    for tobj in T:
        cc=Counter(tobj['colors']); mx=min(cc.values()); cands=[c for c,n in cc.items() if n==mx]
        marks=[c for c in cands if sc.get(c,0)>0]
        rc=marks[0] if marks else min(cands,key=lambda c:(cc[c],c))
        pos=[(y,x) for y,x in tobj['cells'] if g[y][x]==rc]
        if len(pos)!=1: continue
        py,px=pos[0]
        ty,tx=tobj['top']
        pat={(y-tobj['top'][0],x-tobj['top'][1]):g[y][x] for y,x in tobj['cells']}
        for s_ in S:
            if list(s_['colors'])[0]!=rc: continue
            ny,nx=s_['top'][0]-py, s_['top'][1]-px
            for (dy,dx),v in pat.items():
                yy,xx=ny+dy, nx+dx
                if 0<=yy<len(O) and 0<=xx<len(O[0]): O[yy][xx]=v
    return O
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    I,O=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    R=f(I); print(k,R==O)
T=G['Test input']
print(json.dumps(f(T)))

from collections import Counter,defaultdict
# Hypothesis: seeds mark the cell where template's RAREST color sits. Verify per demo with exhaustive unique mapping check.
def comps(g,bg,conn):
    seen=set(); res=[]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); D=[(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)] if conn==4 else [(a,b) for a in(-1,0,1) for b in(-1,0,1) if(a,b)!=(0,0)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)];c=[];seen.add((i,j))
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop();c.append((y,x))
                    for di,dj in D:
                        n=(y+di,x+dj)
                        if 0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W and g[n[0]][n[1]]!=bg and n not in seen:
                            seen.add(n);st.append(n)
                ys=[p[0] for p in c];xs=[p[1] for p in c]
                res.append({'cells':sorted(c),'top':(min(ys),min(xs)),
                            'size':len(c),'colors':{g[y][x] for y,x in c}})
    return res
for k in ['Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    I=G[k+' input'];O=G[k+' output']
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ob=comps(I,bg,4); S=[o for o in ob if o['size']==1]; T=[o for o in ob if o['size']>1]
    ok=True
    for s_ in S:
        cy,cx=s_['top']; sc=list(s_['colors'])[0]
        hit=False
        for tobj in T:
            cc=tobj['colors']
            if sc not in cc: continue
            pos=[(y-tobj['top'][0],x-tobj['top'][1]) for y,x in tobj['cells'] if I[y][x]==sc]
            # anchor = rarest color cell within template
            cnt={c:n for c,n in Counter(cc).items()}
            rc=min(cnt,key=lambda c:(cnt[c],c))
            if rc!=sc: continue
            dy,dx=pos[0]
            pat={(y-tobj['top'][0],x-tobj['top'][1]):I[y][x] for y,x in tobj['cells']}
            out=[r[:] for r in I]
            for (py_,px_),v in pat.items():
                yy,xx=cy+py_-dy, cx+px_-dx
                if 0<=yy<len(out) and 0<=xx<len(out[0]): out[yy][xx]=v
            if out==O: ok&=True; hit=True
            del out
        print(s_['top'],'seed',sc,'-> templates:',hit)

def get_comps(I_,bg_):
    H,W=len(I_),len(I_[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if seen[i][j] or I_[i][j]==bg_: continue
            col_=I_[i][j];c={(i,j)};st=[(i,j)];seen[i][j]=True
            while st:
                y,x=st.pop()
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and I_[ny][nx]!=bg_:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True;c.add((ny,nx));st.append((ny,nx))
            res.append(c)
    return res

def f(I_):
    H,W=len(I_),len(I_[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I_ for x in r); bg_=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

    out=[row[:] for row in I_]
    for s in cs:

        okas=[]
        for a in t:

            okas.append((a,sh))

from collections import Counter as C2
def analyze(n):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'];O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=C2(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(I,bg)
    seeds=[(next(iter(c))[0],next(iter(c))[1],I[next(iter(c))[0]][next(iter(c))[1]]) for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    objs=[sorted(c) for c in cs if len(c)>1]
    return I,O,H,W,bg,seeds,objs
# demo5 & 8: per seed, find ALL valid translations of object into painted region
def analyze_obj(n):
    I,O,H,W,bg,seeds,objs=analyze(n)
    o=objs[0]; vals={t:I[t[0]][t[1]] for t in o}
    cnt=C2(vals.values()); ucell=[t for t,v in vals.items() if cnt[v]==1]
    return I,O,H,W,bg,seeds,o,vals,ucell
I,O,H,W,bg,seeds,o,vals,ucell=analyze_obj(5)
print('demo5 object:',[(t,I[t[0]][t[1]]) for t in sorted(o)])
print('seeds:',seeds)
painted={(i,j) for i,j in [(a,b) for a,b,x,y,z,w,u,v,T in []]} 
painted={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if O[i][j]!=I[i][j]}
D=set(diffs)
# Try: anchor = seed <-> the object cell of the SAME color; if object has a cell equal to seed color? demo5: seed col5; object has 5s everywhere.
# Alternative: seed <-> nearest object cell, OR: object gets reflected/rotated?
# Show exact per-seed painted cluster for demo5
for cy,cx,col in seeds:
    cands=[]
    for ay in range(-20,21):
        for ax in range(-20,21):
            tr=[t+(ay,ax) for t in o]
            ok=True
            for p in tr:
                if 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W and I[p[0]][p[1]]!=bg:
                    if O[p[0]][p[1]]!=I[p[0]][p[1]]: ok=False;break
            # must cover bg->nonbg fully in overlap region: check O==val for all painted cells in tr
            ok=all(O[p[0]][p[1]]==vals.get(t,0) for t,p in zip(o,tr))
            if ok and all(0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W for p in tr) and all(p not in {(cy,cx)} or True for p in tr):
                cands.append((ay,ax))
    print('seed',(cy,cx),'col',col,'cands:',cands[:10])

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from collections import Counter as C2
def analyze(n):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'];O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=C2(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=get_comps([r[:] for r in I],bg)
    seeds=[(c[0],I[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]) for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    objs=[sorted(c) for c in cs if len(c)>1]
    return I,O,H,W,bg,seeds,objs
def f(n):
    I,O,H,W,bg,seeds,objs=analyze(n)
    out=[r[:] for r in I]
    for pos,sc in seeds:
        for oc in objs:
            vs=[(t,I[t[0]][t[1]]) for t in oc]; cnt=C2(v for _,v in vs)
            anc=[(t,v) for t,v in vs if cnt[v]==1]
            if any(a[1]==sc for a in anc):
                anchor=[a for a in anc if a[1]==sc][0][0]
                for t_,vv in [(t,I[t[0]][t[1]]) for t in oc]:
                    p=(pos[0]+t_[0]-anchor[0], pos[1]+t_[1]-anchor[1])
                    if 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W: out[p[0]][p[1]]=vv
                break
    return out
for n in range(1,9):
    ok=f(n)==G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print(n,ok)
print(json.dumps(f(1)))

from collections import Counter as C2
def get_comps(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]);seen=set();out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if (i,j) not in seen and g[i][j]!=bg:
                st=[(i,j)];seen.add((i,j));cl=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop();cl.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        p=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and p not in seen and g[p[0]][p[1]]!=bg:
                            seen.add(p);st.append(p)
                out.append(sorted(cl))
    return out
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]);bg=C2(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=get_comps(I,bg)
    objs=[sorted(c) for c in cs if len(c)>1];seeds=[(c[0],I[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]) for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    T=objs[0];O=[row[:] for row in I]
    for (sr,sc,sv) in seeds:
        anchors=[(ar,ac) for ar,ac in T if I[ar][ac]==sv]
        if not anchors: continue
        placed=False
        for (ar,ac) in anchors:
            tr,tc=sr-ar,sc-ac
            ok=True
            for (ar2,ac2) in T:
                rr,cc=tr+ar2,tc+ac2
                if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W): ok=False;break
                vv=I[ar2][ac2]
                if O[rr][cc]==vv: pass
                elif O[rr][cc]!=bg: ok=False;break
                else: O[rr][cc]=vv
            if ok: placed=True;break
        if placed: break
    return O
print(f(G['Demo pair 5 input'])==G['Demo pair 5 output'], f(G['Demo pair 8 input'])==G['Demo pair 8 output'])
